farmland.name: Farmland
farmland.note: Abundant food; water hungry. Fertilizer runoff travels downstream.

forest.name: Forest
forest.note: Buffers 30% of airborne hazards; stores carbon and limits runoff.

wetland.name: Wetland
wetland.note: Stores 50% of river floodwater. Drain it for food at a future cost.

mangrove.name: Mangrove & reef
mangrove.note: Buffers 40% of coastal waves; fisheries depend on ocean health.

mountain.name: Mountain
mountain.note: Snowpack feeds water. Slopes are exposed to landslides.

desert.name: Desert
desert.note: Low early yields, exceptional solar potential.

oil.name: Oil field
oil.note: Finite fossil reserves. Extraction raises emissions and spill risk.

volcanic.name: Geothermal ridge
volcanic.note: Clean geothermal energy, but exposed to eruptions and earthquakes.

delta.name: River delta
delta.note: Fertile downstream land. Floods and storm surge converge here.

urban.name: City
urban.note: Economic engine with expensive infrastructure and heat exposure.

sea.name: Fishing waters
sea.note: Ocean health controls fishing yields; currents carry spills.
